provenance: heavy marks a weapon that rule 27.3 keeps out of the sewers: the heavy machine gun, the mortar, the one hundred and five millimetre gun, and the anti-tank gun.

Values transcribed from the counter sheet scan described in docs/research/2026-09-07_RV-1_counters_charts.md sections 2 to 4 [S1]. The project writes them in its own layout and ships no counter art (SR-07).

The HMG value: RV-1 section 4 reads 8-20 B12 from the scan. The discovery notes read 6-20 B12 from the lower-resolution photo. The scan wins until the owner checks the counter. Scenarios 1 to 3A use no Russian HMG.
Machine gun penetration equals the firepower factor (rules 2.8 and 17.8).
Rule 18.4: Russian units go berserk on an unmodified morale check roll of 2. The berserk counters are the same types with the berserk flag in the unit state, not different types.

Vehicle values come from the counter sheet scan described in docs/research/2026-09-07_RV-1_counters_charts.md section 5 [S1]: movement points in the top right, main gun calibre in the bottom left, and the two machine gun factors in the bottom right. gun_he_only is the overscored calibre of rule 28.2 and gun_low_velocity is the asterisk of the same rule. survival is the number on the wreck side, which rule 33.9 uses for the crew. armor_key names the row of rule 33.41 in tables/armor.json. transport_pp is the P number on the counter, and rules 47 and 51 give it its meaning.
